reference_basis.instruction: Preserve visible face geometry, freckles, and dark-brown hair appearance. face_geometry.description: Soft heart-to-oval face, widest through the upper cheeks, narrowing through a gently tapered jaw into a small rounded chin. Compact midface; soft cheek volume rather than sharp sculpting.

eyes.description: The visible eye appears pale cool grey-green, with an open softly almond shape. A wink and partial occlusion make exact iris hue, eye spacing, and bilateral geometry uncertain; do not lock greater precision than the reference supports.

brows.description: Dark full brows, low-to-medium set, mostly straight through the inner half with a soft outer arch and natural texture.

nose.description: Relatively narrow straight bridge, compact softly rounded tip, and subtle nostril width; delicate relative to cheek width.

mouth.description: Broad mouth with naturally full lips, defined cupid's bow, and a fuller lower lip. Retain width and volume without filler-like exaggeration.

skin.description: Warm light-to-olive skin with dense natural freckles across the nose and upper cheeks, scattered more lightly across forehead, lower cheeks, neck, and upper body; realistic pores and tonal variation.

hair.description: Dark-brown hair with loose natural waves and face-framing strands, partly pulled back at the crown in the reference. The image does not establish natural length or density; do not treat the updo as identity.

body_proportions.description: Body baseline and stature are not reliably observable in the seated selfie crop; use only independently established canonical data and do not claim the reference confirms full proportions.
